structural_sections.title: Overview
structural_sections.purpose: Structural/header section. Child leaf fields carry the actual answers.

structural_sections.title: Business Process
structural_sections.purpose: Structural/header section. Child leaf fields carry the actual answers.

fields.title: Background
fields.big_question: What is the current situation that led to this initiative?
fields.information_needed: What exists today? What pain points or gaps triggered this? Have there been prior attempts or related projects?

dependencies.reason: Background elaborates the problem framed in the Overview and must stay consistent with it.

fields.title: Business and Market Analysis
fields.big_question: How do market and industry conditions justify this initiative?
fields.information_needed: What are competitors doing? What customer or market trends are relevant? How does this compare to industry benchmarks?

dependencies.reason: Market analysis should align with the general topic introduced in the Overview.
Market analysis explains the competitive/industry context behind the background problem already described.

fields.title: Relevant Historical Data
fields.big_question: What historical evidence supports the need for this initiative?
fields.information_needed: What are the relevant past metrics, volumes, costs, or incidents? Is there trend data over time?

dependencies.reason: Historical data should quantify and support the background narrative already established.

fields.title: Business Objective
fields.big_question: What does the business want to achieve with this initiative?
fields.information_needed: What measurable outcomes are expected? What does success look like? What's the target timeframe?

dependencies.reason: Objectives should align with the overview's stated purpose.
Objectives respond directly to the problem or gap described in Background.
Objectives should reflect the market pressures identified in the market analysis.
Objectives should be grounded in and justified by the historical trend data.

fields.title: Purpose of this Business Requirement
fields.big_question: Why does this BRD exist and what decision does it support?
fields.information_needed: What approval or decision is this document driving? What's in scope and out of scope? Who is the audience for this BRD?

dependencies.reason: The purpose statement should reference the business objective it supports.
A strong purpose statement typically frames itself against the program type, but Program Type is generated after Purpose in this sequence.

fields.title: Program Type
fields.big_question: What kind of initiative is this?
fields.information_needed: Is this a new build, enhancement, compliance mandate, migration, or process improvement? What's driving the classification?

dependencies.reason: Classification is partly driven by the nature of the problem in Background.
The type of program should match the nature of the stated objective.

fields.title: Business Risk
fields.big_question: What could go wrong and how significant is the exposure?
fields.information_needed: What operational, financial, compliance, technical, or reputational risks exist? What's the likelihood and impact of each?

dependencies.reason: Risks should be framed against what the objective is trying to achieve.
Risks may relate to whether the purpose/decision this BRD supports is actually achieved.
Program type strongly shapes the risk category, e.g. compliance program versus new build.

fields.title: Summary (Benefit Analysis)
fields.big_question: What business value or benefit will this initiative deliver?
fields.information_needed: What are the expected financial and non-financial benefits? Over what timeframe? Who validated these estimates?

dependencies.reason: Benefit summary should map directly back to the stated business objective.
Should stay consistent with the stated purpose and scope of the BRD.
Benefit estimates need a historical baseline to compare against.

fields.title: Assumption and Calculation
fields.big_question: How were the benefit figures derived?
fields.information_needed: What assumptions underlie the numbers, such as volumes, costs, or rates? What calculation methodology was used? What are the sensitivities?

dependencies.reason: Calculations must use the assumptions and figures already declared in the Summary.
Calculation inputs such as baseline volumes and costs come from the historical data already established.

fields.title: General Requirement
fields.big_question: What must the solution do at a high level?
fields.information_needed: What are the must-have capabilities? What constraints exist, such as regulatory, technical, or budget? What's explicitly out of scope?

dependencies.reason: Requirements must trace back to the business objective they are meant to satisfy.
The nature and scope of requirements depends on what type of program this is.
Requirements should be consistent with the benefit case that justified the investment.

fields.title: Product / Service Specification
fields.big_question: What exactly is being built or offered?
fields.information_needed: What are the detailed features or functions? What are the technical or product specifications? What variations or tiers exist?

dependencies.reason: Specification is a direct elaboration of the general requirement.

fields.title: Business process impact
fields.big_question: How does this change existing operations?
fields.information_needed: What processes are being replaced, modified, or newly introduced? Who is affected operationally?

dependencies.reason: Impact assessment is a direct extension of the process description.
Impact is measured relative to the current state already described in Background.

fields.title: Description
fields.big_question: What are the step-by-step mechanics of the process?
fields.information_needed: What are the detailed steps, inputs, outputs, and handoffs in the process?

dependencies.reason: Description elaborates the process outlined at the parent level.
Description must stay consistent with the product/service specification.

fields.title: Security
fields.big_question: How is the process and its data protected?
fields.information_needed: What data is sensitive? What access controls, authentication, or encryption are required? What compliance standards apply?

dependencies.reason: Security controls are defined against the process just described.
Security requirements may be shaped by the nature of the product or service itself.

fields.title: Organization and policy
fields.big_question: Who owns this process and under what policies?
fields.information_needed: Which teams or roles are responsible? What policies or governance apply? Are new roles or approvals needed?

dependencies.reason: Organizational and policy implications follow from the process description.
Organizational impact partly depends on the type of program, e.g. new system versus enhancement.

fields.title: Service Delivery Plan (for new application)
fields.big_question: How will this new application or service actually be delivered and operated?
fields.information_needed: What is the delivery or support model? What SLAs apply? Who operates it post-launch?

dependencies.reason: Delivery plan operationalizes the process description.
Delivery plan must align with the organization and policy structure just defined.
This subsection is explicitly conditional ("for new application") on the program type.

fields.title: Complain Handling
fields.big_question: How will customer or user complaints be managed?
fields.information_needed: What channels exist for complaints? What's the escalation and resolution process? What SLAs apply to resolution?

dependencies.reason: Complaint handling relates to the product or service being offered.
Complaint handling procedures build on the process already described.

fields.title: Reporting
fields.big_question: What will be measured and reported, and to whom?
fields.information_needed: What KPIs or metrics matter? Who are the report recipients? What's the reporting frequency and format?

dependencies.reason: Reporting covers the process just described.
Reporting metrics should tie back to the assumptions and calculations used to justify the benefit case.

fields.title: Monitoring (if required)
fields.big_question: How will ongoing performance and risk be tracked?
fields.information_needed: What thresholds or alerts trigger action? What tools or dashboards are used? Who monitors it?

dependencies.reason: Monitoring builds directly on what is being reported.
Monitoring should specifically track the risks already identified.

fields.title: Settlement Plan (if applicable)
fields.big_question: How will financial settlement or reconciliation be handled?
fields.information_needed: What are the settlement terms, parties involved, and timing? How are discrepancies resolved?

dependencies.reason: Settlement relates to the product/service specification.
Settlement terms should be consistent with the financial assumptions and calculations already made.

fields.title: Assumptions and Dependencies
fields.big_question: What must be true, or what external factors, for this to succeed?
fields.information_needed: What are we assuming about systems, teams, timing, or budget? What external dependencies, such as vendors or other projects, exist?

dependencies.reason: Wraps up assumptions across the service description, most directly building on the business process.
Should incorporate any settlement-related assumptions just defined.
Should not contradict assumptions already stated in the Benefit Analysis.

fields.title: Target Ready for Service
fields.big_question: When will this be ready to go live?
fields.information_needed: What's the target completion date? What milestones must be hit before go-live?

dependencies.reason: Target readiness is scoped by the general requirement.
Readiness date should reflect the delivery plan already defined.
Readiness must account for the assumptions and dependencies flagged at the end of Section 3.

fields.title: Commercial Launch
fields.big_question: How and when will this be launched to the market?
fields.information_needed: What's the launch date and go-to-market approach? What marketing or sales activities are planned?

dependencies.reason: Commercial launch is scheduled relative to the readiness date.
Launch timing affects when benefit realization begins, so should reference the benefit summary.

fields.title: Internal Socialization Plan (if applicable)
fields.big_question: How will internal stakeholders be informed and prepared?
fields.information_needed: Who needs to be briefed internally? What training or communication is needed before launch?

dependencies.reason: Internal socialization timing follows from the readiness date.
Internal communication plan should address the organizational impact already described.

fields.title: Rollout Scenario (if any)
fields.big_question: How will this be rolled out — all at once or in phases?
fields.information_needed: Is this a pilot, phased, or big-bang rollout? What are the phase criteria and timeline?

dependencies.reason: Rollout builds on the readiness milestone.
Rollout scenario is a direct extension of the commercial launch plan.
Rollout approach (pilot versus full launch) is often dictated by the program type.

fields.title: Product/Service Retirement Plan
fields.big_question: How and when will this eventually be retired or replaced?
fields.information_needed: What triggers retirement? What's the migration or decommissioning plan for existing users and data?

dependencies.reason: Retirement plan concerns the same product/service that was specified.
Retirement should account for how the rollout was structured, e.g. phased rollout implies phased retirement.
Retirement triggers are often tied to the risks originally identified.
